note: One narrow idea per Short. Public-domain book; hooks and examples in our own modern words.

episodes.title: Win without fighting
episodes.hook: The best way to win a fight is to never have it.
episodes.angle: Supreme skill is beating the problem without open conflict. Example: defusing a coworker feud with one private conversation.

episodes.title: Win first, then fight
episodes.hook: Winners win before the battle starts.
episodes.angle: Victory is decided in preparation. Example: two students, one cramming the night before, one prepared for a week.

episodes.title: Know yourself
episodes.hook: If you don't know your weak spots, you've already lost.
episodes.angle: Know yourself and your opponent and you need not fear a hundred battles. Example: a fighter who knows he gasses out after three rounds.

episodes.title: Pick your battles
episodes.hook: Some battles you win by walking away.
episodes.angle: There are fights you should not fight. Example: not replying to the troll under your post.

episodes.title: All war is deception
episodes.hook: When you're strong, look weak. When you're ready, look unprepared.
episodes.angle: Hide your plans and abilities. Example: the chess player who acts nervous before springing a trap.

episodes.title: Don't announce your plans
episodes.hook: Stop telling people your goals before you reach them.
episodes.angle: Revealing plans invites opposition and drains motivation. Example: the friend who announces his diet and quits by Friday.

episodes.title: Let them underestimate you
episodes.hook: Being underestimated is a gift. Use it.
episodes.angle: Low expectations from opponents are an advantage. Example: the quiet new hire who outperforms the loud one.

episodes.title: Attack what's weak
episodes.hook: Don't hit the wall. Walk around it.
episodes.angle: Avoid the opponent's strength, strike where they are empty. Example: a small shop that wins on service, not price, against a giant.

episodes.title: Be like water
episodes.hook: Water has no shape. That's why nothing can stop it.
episodes.angle: Adapt to circumstances instead of holding a fixed plan. Example: a band that switches to streaming concerts when venues close.

episodes.title: Speed matters
episodes.hook: Nobody ever won by dragging a war out.
episodes.angle: Long campaigns drain everyone; finish things fast. Example: the group project that rots when nobody decides anything.

episodes.title: Leave them a way out
episodes.hook: Never trap someone with no way out.
episodes.angle: A cornered opponent fights to the death; give them an exit. Example: letting your partner save face in an argument.

episodes.title: Never act in anger
episodes.hook: Anger can turn back into joy. A bad decision can't be undone.
episodes.angle: A leader never moves out of rage. Example: the angry text you write, then delete.

episodes.title: Opportunity multiplies
episodes.hook: Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
episodes.angle: Small wins open doors to bigger ones. Example: one freelance gig that leads to three referrals.

episodes.title: Chaos hides chances
episodes.hook: In the middle of chaos there is also opportunity.
episodes.angle: Disorder makes openings for the prepared. Example: a market crash where calm savers buy.

episodes.title: Discipline wins
episodes.hook: Talent wins a game. Discipline wins the war.
episodes.angle: Order and training beat bravery alone. Example: the steady runner who passes the fast starter.
